# Both walk left, and on 258 both reach their platform's left edge and stop (status 0). The caveman's walk
# sets xVel = 0 there, then -1.5 again in the same step, so it slides from x 112 to 102 while friction slows
# it; the hawkman's walk sets them the other way round and it stops dead at x 240. The caveman sets off again
# on 283, stops at the edge again on 284, slides the rest of the way off and falls (287) to the floor below
# (300). The hawkman stops at its edge each time it gets there and never falls.
